parameters.content:
## Enquiry Capture And Follow-Up
A public enquiry form. Gemini tags each enquiry by type and writes a one-line summary, the sender gets an instant reply with matching work samples, and you get an alert. A daily check reminds you of enquiries still unanswered after three days.

parameters.formDescription: Tell me what you need. You will get a reply with relevant work samples straight away, and a personal reply after that.

values.formSubmittedText: Thanks. A confirmation is on its way to your inbox.

return $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(q => String(q.Replied).toUpperCase() !== 'TRUE' && !q['Reminder sent'] && Date.now() - new Date(q.Received).getTime() > 3 * 864e5)
